DP80 cable compatible with UHBR20, dynamic HDR10+, 3D, and HDCP 2.3 for superior visuals. Backward compatible with DP 2.0, and DP 1.4, and supports flawless 7.1/5.1/2.0 uncompressed audio pass-thru
